view.label: Productos Periodo
view.sqlSentence: SELECT invoice_detail.item, product.name description, SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 2), 0)), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2), 0)), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, 0, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 2))), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, 0, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2))) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE product.id = item.product AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND ( invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? OR invoice.issue_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(?, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(?, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ) AND invoice.type = ? GROUP BY 1,2
